source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB boot-option setter; getter is next separate read case.

source_snapshot.procedure: Set parameter-5 one-time/persistent legacy/UEFI PXE/disk/CD/setup/USB flags, write parameters 0/4/3, restart and inspect BIOS/boot.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command success and correct selected boot path.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; exact bytes requested; chassis-write warning.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Does not define allowlist, readback, reboot or flag cleanup.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires one target/mode/persistence choice, pre/post Get Boot Options, console evidence and restore.
historical_reviews.history: Getter provides evidence but no write authorization.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No boot-setting or restart action is authorized by Review.

original_test_intent: Set and functionally prove each approved one-time or persistent boot target/mode, then clear or restore boot flags.
original_method: Write raw 0x00/0x08 boot-option parameters, restart the host, observe actual BIOS/UEFI boot and inspect settings.
manual_activity: Owner selects one boot device, legacy/UEFI and one-time/persistent scope and approves restart/recovery.
engineer_actions: Approve boot target and sensitive-bit exclusions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek avoids guessing bytes but provides no executable coverage; the source's parameter 0/3/4 writes also require independent justification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected parameter-5 write for one approved target, read back with 0x00/0x09, restart once, verify, then clear/restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All source device/mode/persistence values and extra writes remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Test each required matrix cell separately with pre/post readback, one reboot, console/OS oracle and verified cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds strict bit allowlist and recovery gates without reducing boot coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Write completion or BIOS readback alone does not prove actual boot; one target cannot cover others.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong or persistent flags can strand boot or redirect future starts.

project_override_considerations: A high-level bootdev tool is equivalent only for the same mode/persistence/device bits and must preserve readback, functional boot and cleanup evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and parameter-5 boot-setting intent align; extra parameter writes are insufficiently justified but do not erase the primary operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core boot operation is clear; platform choices, approval and recovery are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Turns a broad disruptive command list into independently approved matrix cells with readback, actual boot proof and guaranteed cleanup.
independent_technical_reasoning: One-time versus persistent and legacy versus UEFI flags alter different future-boot state, while each device selector has a separate availability oracle. Parameter readback must precede the reboot, and actual console/OS evidence plus valid-flag cleanup is required before another matrix cell can begin.
